_readme: Moodily Learn curriculum, migrated from the original index.html STAGES array. Certificate labels were neutralised: certificates (where offered) are issued by the provider, not Moodily. TODO(owner): add verified provider URLs and confirm each course still exists and is free.

stages.title: AI Fundamentals
stages.goal: Understand what AI is and build the foundational literacy to talk about it with confidence.
stages.project: Build a one-page "Explain AI" deck for a non-technical audience.

stages.title: Productive AI Tools
stages.goal: Use the top free AI tools to multiply your personal output.
stages.project: Put together your own AI toolkit workflow document.
stages.skill: Use AI tools to finish everyday work faster.

stages.title: AI Workflows
stages.goal: Automate repetitive work without writing code.
stages.project: Build one working automation for a real business task.

stages.title: AI Agents & Code
stages.goal: Build simple AI agents and ship them publicly.
stages.project: Publish an AI agent project to your GitHub portfolio.
stages.skill: Create AI agents with a public GitHub portfolio.

stages.title: Apply — Projects & Client-Ready Skills
stages.goal: Turn what you have learned into client-ready skills.

courses.name: LinkedIn content writing for AI creators

stages.project: Pitch or deliver a small AI-related project for a real client.
stages.skill: Package your skills into a small, sellable service.
